It took me a year to understand electronics only to realize that it is incredibly simple.

  • Electrons are negative charged, they do not like each other an will repel each other.
  • When you push too many electrons on one plate of a condenser by force, then the electrons at the other plate will panic and try to flee as far away from the angry electron mob.
  • When a happy electron flies through space and crosses between an North and South magnet then it will be forced to move left.
  • When an electron is sitting happily in a copper wire together with his other electron friends (but not too close they don't like each other) and that copper wire is forced into a magnetic field then all electrons are forced to move left in that wire since there is no other way to go.
  • An electron that moves through space creates magnetic fields. Just like boat waves.
  • When 2 electrons move together through space, then they do not experience each other magnetic waves. But the rest that dies not move with them does.
  • When an electron gets accelerated through a transistor then most of the electrons travel too fast to slow down and enter the base exit.

Ah yes and this one.

  • Two magnets repelling each other is not magic or mystical. It is nothing more than electrons hating each other and repel the other magnet that is just like them. You need force to bring those magnets together and that requires energy. When you let the magnets go then that energy gets released again. It is the exact same thing as compressing a metal spring, or pulling a metal spring. No free energy!
